title: SakuraChat
description:
[EN] With this plugin you can decorate your chat      
[RU] С помощью этого плагина вы можете украсить свой чат
body:
![SakuraPluginIco](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/832b74700a5c20f0ee5675dbc41269545dd918c6.png) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/sakurachat?color=00AF5C&label=Downloads&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/sakurachat "Modrinth Downloads")

![ad](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20f793a81f622934df815a221e7b5b354628b4e6_0.webp)

Русский

С помощью данного плагина вы сможете поменять чат на вашем сервере в MInecraft, так же плагин хорошо настраеваемый что поможет сделать чат ещё красивее и уютнее. Данный плагин предназначен только для изменения внешнего вида чата.

Конфиг | Config


Config

config.yml

```yml # Placeholders: # {playername} – player name (EssentialsX nickname if set, else username) # – chat message (already run through emoji + censorship, if enabled) # # Any PlaceholderAPI placeholder can be used directly in the format, e.g.: # %luckperms_prefix%, %luckperms_suffix%, %player_health%, etc. # # /papi ecloud download LuckPerms, /papi reload lang: en chat: colors: enable: false permission: sakurachat.color global-chat: enable: false trigger: '!' local-radius: 100 vanish-bypass: true formats: default: '&r%luckperms_prefix%{playername}%luckperms_suffix%&r: &r' # For: global-chat: enable: true local: '&eL &r|&r %luckperms_prefix%{playername}%luckperms_suffix%&r: &7' global: '&aG &r|&r %luckperms_prefix%{playername}%luckperms_suffix%&r: &7' messages: enable: false join: '&a+ &e{playername} &ajoined the server' quit: '&c- &e{playername} &cleft the server' censorship: enable: false character: '*' anti-stretch: enable: false min-length: 4 words: - Test # - Detects Cyrillic/Latin visual lookalikes (е->e, о->o, а->a, р->p, х->x …) # - Detects leet-speak digit substitutes (0->o, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, @->a …) # - Detects letter-stretching evasion, e.g. "Teest" or "TTest" for "Test" # - Multi-word phrases matched across spaces ```

![splitter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42c0138331a26035c811980f010c088f35dfc09b.png)

Кастомные эмодзи | Custom Emoji


emoji.yml

emoji.yml

```yml enable: true emojis: smile: symbol: ☺ placeholder: :) smile1: symbol:  placeholder: ':smile:' # sad1: # symbol: "☹" # placeholder: ":sad:" # heart1: # symbol: "❤" # placeholder: ":heart:" ```
